exposure: obstetrical healthcare workers' knowledge of PFD
obstetrical healthcare workers' attitude towards PFD
treatment or nursing experience of PFD
PFD-related departmental setup of their hospital
outcome: obstetrical healthcare workers' practice regarding PFD
cohort: The study participants were 1545 obstetrical healthcare workers from 31 provinces in the People's Republic of China.
finding: Most obstetrical healthcare workers demonstrate knowledge and a positive attitude towards PFD but frequently fail to routinely provide PFD counseling and mentoring to patients, with their practice being influenced by various personal and departmental factors.
